items.title: Manny Albam interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: he was Dell Barkhart’s roommate and they went to the Conservatory of Budapest together

ctx.x: And it scared the hell out of me. And I started studying. I asked around and people said, “you ought to go to Tibor Serly and study.” I had never studied writing or anything. And he was Dell Barkhart’s roommate and they went to the Conservatory of Budapest together and they studied with Kodaly. Kodaly was their teacher. So I figured, yeah, why not? And he really put me into a whole different way of thinking about form, about overall form, and I’d already thought about longer works. Barnet got me to do something…
